game_title: And/Or Locks – Coral Reef Shallows Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round, smugglers strike the ship's hull, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the ship's hull from smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows: keep the lock_progress meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lock_progress drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while lock_progress > 0.
